object: """Our Closet In Your Neighborhood (OCIYN) is a free mobile program that provides basic necessities of food and clothing, as well as access to services and benefits, to families and individuals in need. The bus visits host sites in under-resourced neighborhoods and central locations with fresh, healthy produce and pantry staples, a mini pop-up clothing shop, and an onsite social workerThis program provides:- Food- Clothing- Navigation servicesVisitors receive fresh, locally-sourced produce and pantry staples and are welcome to shop for 10 free, quality items of clothing, shoes, and accessories per person (with a limit of 25 total per family to allow for all to receive what they need). A JFCS social worker is present at every OCIYN event to connect those in need to additional services and benefits for which they may be eligibleOCIYN also provides customized packages of emergency clothing delivered straight to those in need, as well as food package delivery to homebound clientsTo learn more about these services or upcoming pop-up events, contact 267-256-2179 or [email_protected]."""
